sections.heading: Biography
paragraphs: Eleanor Stegmeier is a founding partner of Stegmeier, Gelbart, Schwartz, & Benavente, LLP and is considered one of Orange County’s most accomplished family law attorneys. She has been licensed to practice law since 1978 and has been a Certified Family Law Specialist since 1983.

Ms. Stegmeier is certified in mediation by the Pepperdine University School of Law, Strauss Institute, which is one of the top mediation training programs in the United States. She has completed two programs with the Strauss Institute. One was a program which focused primarily on Family Law custody issues, and the other was a six-day training program for Dispute Resolution, “Mediating the Litigated Case.”
She is also certified in mediation by the American Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers, which offers its training program exclusively to Fellows of the AAML.

In 1989, Ms. Stegmeier became a Fellow in the American Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers. She is also a Founding Fellow of the Society of Fellows of the Orange County Bar Association and is on the Board of Directors for the National AAML Foundation.

Ms. Stegmeier has been named a U.S. News “Best Lawyer” every year since 1995, which is determined by a peer vote among Orange County family lawyers. In 2010 she was awarded the publication’s highest award for family law in Orange County: “Orange County Family Lawyer of the Year”.
In 1998, Ms. Stegmeier was named the Family Law Trial Attorney of the Year by the Orange County Trial Lawyers Association.

In 1999, she was the recipient of the prestigious Charles Garrity Award, which is given only periodically by the Family Law Section of the Orange County Bar Association. This award is given for excellence and professionalism in the practice of Family Law.
Ms. Stegmeier was named one of the Best Lawyers in Orange County by Orange Coast Magazine every year that the magazine published a list.

Ms. Stegmeier has also been listed in the Los Angeles Times Magazine’s “Super Lawyers” edition each year since 2004; she has also been honored with the “Top Attorneys In Southern California” distinction by Los Angeles Magazine.
She is one of only two Orange County Family lawyers inducted as a Fellow in the American College of Trial Lawyers.
Ms. Stegmeier was a member of the State Bar of California’s Family Law Advisory Commission for four years, including two years as Chairperson.

In 2014, her alma mater, Western State University, School of Law, honored her by induction into their Hall of Fame. Ms. Stegmeier has been lecturing statewide on Family Law subjects for numerous educational, civic, and professional organizations since 1981.
In November 2019, ACFLS Orange County recognized Eleanor Stegmeier with the Excellence in Family Law Lifetime Achievement Award.

sections.heading: Biography
paragraphs: Saul Gelbart is a Founding Partner of Stegmeier, Gelbart, Schwartz & Benavente, LLP. He has successfully litigated hundreds of cases, and is known in Orange County for being one of Family Law’s most respected and sought after attorneys. He specializes in litigating family law’s most difficult and complex issues.

Mr. Gelbart is a Certified Family Law Specialist, and has served as a Judge Pro Tem, a Special Master, and a lecturer for continuing legal education. Most of Mr. Gelbart’s lectures relate to trial tactics, trial presentation, evidence, and the use of math at trial. The audiences for his presentations have included the American Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers, the Association of Certified Family Law Specialists, the Orange County Bar Association, the San Diego County Bar Association, the Beverly Hills Bar Association, and the Judicial Continuing Education Program.

Mr. Gelbart is a Fellow in the American Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers, and served as the President of the Southern California Chapter in 2008-2009. He is presently the Southern California representative on the National Board of Governors for the AAML. Mr. Gelbart has served the AAML in a variety of other positions, most notably as a Dean of the 2007 Advanced Trial Advocacy Institute, as a Dean of the 2019 Advanced Trial Advocacy Institute, as Vice-President of Membership from 2005-2007, and as legal counsel from 2009-2011. He has served on the AAML Board of Directors for over seven years.
A personal highlight for Mr. Gelbart was being honored to introduce The Honorable Ronald George, Chief Justice of the California Supreme Court, at the AAML’s award ceremony for Justice George.

Mr. Gelbart is a Fellow in the International Academy of Family Lawyers, a worldwide association of practicing lawyers who are recognized by their peers as the most experienced and skilled family law specialists in their respective countries.

Mr. Gelbart was awarded the “Family Law Person of the Year” in 2017 by the Southern California Chapter of the American Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers, and Best Lawyers named Mr. Gelbart the 2017 “Orange County Family Law Attorney of the Year.”
Super Lawyers Magazine has named Mr. Gelbart as one of the Top 50 lawyers (all disciplines) in Orange County and he has been named in the Best Lawyers in America publication every year since 2009.
In October 2019, The American College of Family Trial Lawyers selected Mr. Gelbart to join this select group of 100 of the top family law trial lawyers from across the United States.
Mr. Gelbart enjoys sports and travel.

sections.heading: Community Involvement
paragraphs: Mr. Gelbart was raised in Orange County and is an active community member. He served on the Board of Directors for Congregation Shir Ha-Ma’alot for six years, on the Board of Education for St. John’s Episcopal School for four years, and served as a coach in the Trabuco Canyon Little League for nine years. He has been married for over 35 years and has three children, two sons-in-law, and three grandchildren.

sections.heading: Biography
paragraphs: Jason M. Schwartz is a Partner at Stegmeier, Gelbart, Schwartz & Benavente, LLP, and exclusively practices family law. Mr. Schwartz has been with the firm since he was admitted to the State Bar of California in the summer of 2001. He is known as one of Orange County family law’s most sought after lecturers, and for being one of the most active members of the Association of Certified Law Specialists.

Mr. Schwartz earned his Juris Doctor Degree from Western State University College of Law in December 2000, and his Bachelor of Science Degree from the University of North Texas, where he majored in political science with a double minor in criminal justice and journalism.

Mr. Schwartz has had an impressive career with the Association of Certified Family Law Specialists. He became a Certified Family Law Specialist in 2007. In 2011, he became a member of the ACFLS, where he has served on the Executive Board of the Orange County section since 2012. He has also served as the organization’s Associate Director. He has been a Board Member on the State Board of Directors since 2014.

In addition, he has been a member of the Family Law Section of the Orange County Bar Association since 2001. Mr. Schwartz has successfully litigated some of family law’s most complex multiple-day trials regarding child custody and visitation, domestic violence, child support and spousal support, attorney fees, characterization, valuation and division of community estate assets, valuation of business interests, as well as trials on the issues of the validity of a premarital agreement, transmutations, breach of fiduciary duty and date of separation.

You can often find Mr. Schwartz as a presenter or panelist sharing his family law knowledge at some of Orange County’s most significant professional, legal and civic organizations. In his spare time, he stays active by running, and spending days at the beach with his wife, Susy, who is an attorney practicing immigration law.

sections.heading: Biography
paragraphs: Robert Benavente is a named Partner at Stegmeier, Gelbart, Schwartz & Benavente, LLP. He has successfully litigated hundreds of cases involving the most complex and contested issues in family law — high-conflict custody, business valuations, breach of fiduciary duty, tracing, characterization of assets and liabilities, and cash flow analysis for self-employed individuals. His trial skills, together with his dignified and confident demeanor, have earned him a reputation as one of the most respected family law attorneys in Orange County.

In 2016, Mr. Benavente was admitted as a Fellow of the American Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers (AAML), widely considered the preeminent organization of family law attorneys in the nation. Eight years later, in 2024–2025, he was elected President of the AAML’s Southern California Chapter. In addition to his leadership of the Southern California Chapter, Mr. Benavente has been appointed to governing bodies at the AAML’s national office in Chicago, where he currently serves on the Board of Directors of the AAML Foundation — the Academy’s charitable arm supporting families and children affected by divorce — and he is the only Southern California Fellow on the AAML House of Governors.

Mr. Benavente is a frequent lecturer for legal organizations on family law topics, including trial procedure and strategy, complex custody, support, and financial litigation issues, and emerging developments in the field.

His practice has been devoted exclusively to family law since 2000. He has been a Board Certified Family Law Specialist since 2007, and has been named a “Super Lawyer” by Los Angeles magazine every year since 2014, as well as listed annually in The Best Lawyers in America for Family Law, published by U.S. News & World Report, since the same year.

Mr. Benavente is a Past President (2014) of the Family Law Section of the Orange County Bar Association and a member of the Association of Certified Family Law Specialists. In May 2015, he was featured in the “Ask the Expert” column of Orange Coast Magazine, where he discussed criteria for selecting a divorce attorney and factors affecting child custody and spousal support.
Mr. Benavente enjoys traveling to tropical destinations. When he is not traveling, he stays active with his two sons.

sections.heading: Biography
paragraphs: George H. Peniche, III, is a Partner with Stegmeier Gelbart, Schwartz & Benavente, LLP. Mr. Peniche is a Certified Family Law Specialist and his practice is focused on all aspects of family law litigation, including child custody, visitation, child support, spousal support, domestic violence, paternity, and division of assets.

Mr. Peniche was born and raised in Orange County, California, and graduated from the University of San Diego with Bachelor of Arts in Business Administration. During college, Mr. Peniche was a Division I Football Athlete. Additionally, Mr. Peniche was a member of the Delta Sigma Pi business fraternity and founding member of the Alpha Phi Omega community service fraternity.

Mr. Peniche earned his Juris Doctor from Chapman University, Fowler School of Law. During law school, Mr. Peniche knew he wanted to focus his practice exclusively to family law. As such, he externed for multiple well-known family law firms in Orange County.

Mr. Peniche has practiced family law exclusively since being admitted to the bar. Prior to joining the firm, Mr. Peniche was a Senior Associate Attorney at one of the largest and prominent family law firms in Orange County, wherein he handled high-net-worth and complex cases.

Mr. Peniche has been selected and recognized to Best Lawyers- Ones to Watch. This award is given to attorneys who are earlier in their careers for outstanding professional excellence in private practice.

Additionally, Mr. Peniche is a graduate from the National Family Law Trial Institute. The Institute is the preeminent litigation skills course dedicated exclusively to Family Law. At the Institute, Mr. Peniche trained with some of the foremost experts in Family Law and refined his litigation skills and techniques.

Mr. Peniche believes in keeping his clients involved and informed during each step of their case from inception through settlement or trial. Playing sports his entire life and being a Division I athlete, Mr. Peniche is very competitive. Mr. Peniche uses his competitive edge to aggressively fight for his client’s interests, while also ensuring that the client understands both the strengths and weaknesses of their cases to allow them to make the best and most informed decisions.
In his spare time, Mr. Peniche enjoys spending time with his family, attending his children’s sporting events, playing basketball, and staying active.

sections.heading: Biography
paragraphs: Brandon P. Kelsey is a Partner with Stegmeier, Gelbart, Schwartz & Benavente, LLP. Mr. Kelsey’s practice is focused on family law trial litigation — he is experienced in all types of family law matters, from simple support actions to complex high net worth marital estates.

Mr. Kelsey, a native of the Chicago area, graduated from Illinois State University with a Bachelor of Arts in Political Science and Minor in Music Performance. Mr. Kelsey then completed his Juris Doctorate (J.D.) from the University of San Diego School of Law in 2012. Mr. Kelsey was admitted to practice law in California in 2012, and federally in the United States District Court for the Central District of California in early 2013.

Following his admission to the California State Bar, Mr. Kelsey began his practice conducting trial work in family law and criminal matters for a boutique firm in Orange County, before moving on to become a Senior Attorney for one of the largest family law firms in Orange County, where he practiced family law exclusively. Mr. Kelsey then worked as in-house counsel for State Farm before returning to the exclusive practice of family law.

Mr. Kelsey is a Certified Family Law Specialist, certified by the State Bar of California Board of Legal Specialization. Mr. Kelsey’s practice is limited to family law exclusively, and focuses on trial of complex matters involving business valuation, complex support scenarios, high-net worth individuals and families, and domestic violence matters. Mr. Kelsey has successfully litigated dozens of trials and evidentiary hearings in Orange County and beyond, and continues to dedicate his practice to exceptional trial work. Mr. Kelsey also serves as an in-house mentor and teacher for the firm’s associates, together with Managing Partner Saul Gelbart. Mr. Kelsey is actively involved in the Orange County family law community, and regularly attends continuing education events designed to refine family law trial skills and support the practice of family law in Southern California. Mr. Kelsey recently served as a Guest Lecturer for the Orange County Bar Association: Young Lawyers’ Division on the topic of Discovery.

During his law school education, Mr. Kelsey excelled particularly in written and oral advocacy, achieving Honors in Lawyering Skills I & II, Honors with the USD Criminal Clinic, and Honors in Evidence Advocacy Lab. Mr. Kelsey also received the CALI Excellence for the Future Award for his outstanding performance in the school’s most advance trial skills course, Advanced Trial Advocacy. Mr. Kelsey further participated as a competing member the USD National Mock Trial Team. Mr. Kelsey continues to serve as a guest judge for mock trial competitions.
In addition to his educative pursuits at USD School of Law, Mr. Kelsey also sat as the Principal Trumpet of the University of San Diego Symphony Orchestra.

sections.heading: Biography
paragraphs: Eric J. Sather joined Stegmeier, Gelbart, Schwartz & Benavente, LLP as a file clerk in November 2014. Mr. Sather received his Juris Doctor degree from San Francisco Law School in San Francisco, California and Bachelor of Arts degree from University of Washington in Seattle, Washington.

In March 2026, Mr. Sather passed the Certified Family Law Specialist exam, certified by the State Bar of California Board of Legal Specialization. Mr. Sather serves on the Orange County Bar Association (“OCBA”) Board of Directors, co-chairs the OCBA Lawyer Well-Being Committee, and is an active participant in several other OCBA committees and groups.

In 2024, Mr. Sather completed his fourth term as a Division Leader for the OCBA, Young Lawyers Division (“YLD”). Mr. Sather served as the YLD Chair for 2024 after he was elected YLD’s Chair-Elect for 2023, led YLD’s Business Development committee in 2022, and served as its Affiliates and Sections Liaison in 2021.
In May 2024, Mr. Sather graduated from the National Family Law Trial Institute; the premier litigation skills course dedicated exclusively to Family Law.

In June 2022, Mr. Sather attended the American Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers (“AAML”) Institute for Family Law Associates in Chicago, Illinois, attending programs taught by AAML President Cary Mogerman, and Institute Co-Chairs, AAML Immediate Past President Elizabeth Green Lindsey, and Maureen Glackin.
Mr. Sather has been married since 2015 and has three daughters. He enjoys attending live sporting events, the outdoors, and spending time with friends and family.

sections.heading: Biography
paragraphs: Samantha L. Weissman is an associate attorney with Stegmeier, Gelbart, Schwartz & Benavente, LLP. Ms. Weissman’s practice is devoted exclusively to Family Law.

In March 2026, Ms. Weissman passed the Certified Family Law Specialist exam, certified by the State Bar of California Board of Legal Specialization. Originally from Los Angeles, Ms. Weissman completed her undergraduate degree at the University of California, Irvine where she graduated cum laude with a degree in English. Thereafter she attended law school at the University of San Diego, School of Law.

While in law school Ms. Weissman focused her studies on International Law, receiving high marks in every international law class. In the summer of 2013, she studied abroad in both Barcelona, Spain, and London, England. Thereafter, in 2014, she was selected for a pupillage at 11 Stone Buildings Barristers’ Chambers at Lincoln’s Inn in London.

During law school, Ms. Weissman was an active member of the school’s community. She reinstated the McCormick Chapter of Phi Alpha Delta and served its Justice. She served as a Senior Associate on the Journal of Climate and Energy Law and as an Article Contributor to the Law School’s newspaper, Motions. Ms. Weissman served as a 1L section & class representative, as a member of the Student Bar Association – Executive Budget Committee, and, as a mentor in the first-year mentorship program. She continues to volunteer as a guest judge for first-year oral arguments.

After graduating and passing the California Bar Exam in 2016, Ms. Weissman turned her focus to family law. From 2016 to 2021, Ms. Weissman served as the sole family law associate for a boutique law firm in Orange County. While there, she assisted in a wide variety of family law matters and was lauded by clients for her compassion, diligence, and thoroughness.
In her free time, Ms. Weissman enjoys spending time with her family.

Ms. Weissman is a member of the Orange County Bar Association, Family Law section and the San Diego Family Bar Association. She is also a graduate of the National Family Law Trial Institute; the premier litigation skills course dedicated exclusively to Family Law.

sections.heading: Biography
paragraphs: Natali Beltran is an associate attorney with Stegmeier, Gelbart, Schwartz & Benavente, LLP.

Ms. Beltran was born and raised in Bakersfield, California. After graduating from Foothill High School, Ms. Beltran completed her undergraduate degree at the University of California San Diego, where she received Provost Honors in 2015, 2016, and 2017. Thereafter, Ms. Beltran attended law school at California Western School of Law, where she received her Juris Doctor degree.

While in law school, Ms. Beltran participated in the Community Law Project, San Diego Volunteer Lawyer Program, and the Legal Aid Society. Ms. Beltran was inducted into the Pro Bono Honors Society, which recognizes the contribution of students who volunteer a minimum of 50 hours at an organization that supports underserved populations. Ms. Beltran was also president of the Family Law Society and was on the board of the La Raza Law Student Association. During law school, Ms. Beltran knew she wanted to focus her practice exclusively to family law and externed for family law firms in San Diego County and Kern County.
Ms. Beltran became licensed to practice law in 2022 and has been practicing family law exclusively since then. Ms. Beltran is a member of the Orange County Bar Association.
In her spare time, Ms. Beltran enjoys traveling, spending time with her family, and going to the dog beach with her Australian Shepherd.

sections.heading: Biography
paragraphs: Jameson Adame is an Associate Attorney with Stegmeier, Gelbart, Schwartz & Benavente, LLP.

Mr. Adame is originally from Riverside County, California, and completed his bachelor’s degree in English at the University of California, Riverside. He then attended law school at Seattle University in Seattle, Washington.

During law school, Mr. Adame discovered the challenge and satisfaction that came with working in family law, working as a law clerk for a local Seattle firm. Mr. Adame was active, becoming a member and eventually President of the International Law Society, as well as being a member and the eventual membership retention chair for Seattle University’s chapter of Phi Alpha Delta.

After graduating from law school in 2020, Mr. Adame returned to California and went on to take and pass the California Bar Exam, becoming a member of the State Bar of California in 2021. Since passing the bar, Mr. Adame’s practice has continued to be exclusively focused on family law.

Within his first year of practicing law, Mr. Adame became a board member of the Southwest Riverside County Bar Association. In his free time, Mr. Adame enjoys spending time with his wife reading, travelling, and playing board games.

sections.heading: Biography
paragraphs: Shelley Rich Manning has dedicated 100 percent of her career to practicing Family Law since 2005, when she obtained her license in the State of California. Ms. Manning graduated from the University of California, Santa Barbara, in 2001 with a Bachelor of Arts in Sociology and a minor in Women’s Studies. She received a Juris Doctor, cum laude, from California Western School of Law in 2005.

Ms. Manning also studied abroad in London, England at The College of Law of England and Wales. Ms. Manning served as a Judicial Extern to Justice Alex McDonald, California Court of Appeal, Fourth Appellate District, Division One.

Throughout her career, she has done extensive volunteer work. She served as a Court Appointed Special Advocate (CASA) for several years for Voices for Children, an organization that increases awareness about the foster care system and advocates enhancing the quality of life for foster children. Ms. Manning has been licensed as a foster parent and has also volunteered for Make-A-Wish Foundation. She has served on the Harbor Day School Alumni Advisory Council.
Ms. Manning is a member of the Orange County Bar Association, Family Law Section. She enjoys traveling with her husband Patrick, who is a police lieutenant, and their two children.

sections.heading: Biography
paragraphs: Christi D. Rios is a distinguished family law attorney and founding partner of Rios & Rios, LLP, and she has dedicated over 25 years to exclusively serving families throughout Orange County, California. As a recognized leader in the family law community, Ms. Rios combines exceptional legal expertise with a compassionate approach to help clients navigate the most challenging periods of their lives.

Ms. Rios served as Commissioner on the Family Law Advisory Commission of the State Bar of California from 2009-2011, where she helped shape family law policy and practice standards throughout California. Ms. Rios has been selected to Super Lawyers for 2011-2026, a distinction limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. This selection is based on evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice, a distinction that confirms what others in the industry know: she is hardworking, prepared, and knowledgeable family law lawyer who works extremely hard for her clients’ objectives.
